pkgmetadata.longdescription: tncd is a bridge allowing AGWPE-compatible client applications (PAT/Winlink, Paracon, Xastir) to communicate with KISS TNCs over serial, TCP, or Bluetooth. It implements AX.25 layer 2 connected mode with support for multiple simultaneous TNC ports.

use.flag: Enable Bluetooth SPP support via D-Bus (dbus-python, PyGObject)
